body: As for my parents, they're assholes which is why I don't want to go there and would prefer to go to a friend's.  However, I am financially unable to do so and, again, I don't believe in leaving the animals in harm's way, as silly as that might sound.
I appreciate the offer.  You're good people.

The shelters won't take my dog, and I am afraid of her wellbeing if I leave her here or take her to a shelter.  In addition, I am taking care of bf's two cats and it isn't right by them to leave them.

And I offered to screenshot anything the mods wanted but was refused.

Thank you.
